string.text: 40 round magazine
Extended PMAG 40 AR magazine decreases the number of reloads in combat.
60 round magazine
High capacity SureFire MAG5-60 significantly facilitates fighting against superior enemy forces.
Tactical foregrip

Handguard replacement and the addition of a tactical foregrip improves handling of the firearm. Moreover, new handguard is equipped with multiple Picatinny rails, which enables the installation of additional tactical devices.
Tactical device
Insight AN/PEQ-16a tactical block combines the functions of a laser sight and a tactical flashlight. Particularly useful in night conditions.
Tritium sights
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Anatomical pistol grip
Provides better grip for the right hand.
Bayonet

Standard L3A1 bayonet allows to use the weapon in melee combat. Due to constructional characteristics of the weapon, suppressors and underbarrel grenade launchers cannot be used with the bayonet installed.
Trigger calibration
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Trigger tuning
Modification of the trigger mechanism increases rate of fire, at the cost of durability.
Improved feeding mechanism
Decreases the probability of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
Improved muzzle brake
Significantly reduces muzzle climb and felt recoil.
Barrel adjustment
Reduces bullet dispersion, which in turn improves accuracy.
Faster twist rate
Increases muzzle velocity, thus improving the flatness of the trajectory. Useful for long range fire.
Improved recoil pad
Anatomical rubberized recoil pad reduces felt recoil.
Balanced bolt
Balanced bolt carrier group reduces the muzzle climb, as well as reduces the probability of malfunctions.
More durable parts
Improves durability of the gun by replacing weapon parts with their strengthened counterparts.
Lightweight parts
Noticeably reduces weight by replacing weapon parts with their light-alloy counterparts.
Improved fire selector
Decreases the probability of malfunctions related to fire selector issues.
